usage: 「褸」is the spoken form and is more common than 「外套」 in everyday conversation.
It is usually used with the classifier 「件」, for example: “一件褸” (a jacket).
It commonly appears with verbs such as “wear,” “take off,” and “bring.”
It is often mentioned when talking about cold weather or going out.
